senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. f. Keturah, the second wife of Abraham.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 61:6">Gen. R. s. 61</cite> <he>ק׳</he> … <he>זו הגר</he> K. is Hagar; Tanḥ. Ḥayé 8; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 61:6">ib.</cite> <he>ק׳ שהית׳ קשורה כנוד</he> she was called K. (the tied up, v. <cite ref="S00825"><he>קָטַר</he> II</cite>), because she was tied up like a water bag (was chaste).

<cite ref="Zevachim 62b:1">Zeb. 62ᵇ</cite> <he>קרי עלייהו בני ק׳</he> (not <he>עליהם</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 70) he cried out over them, sons of K. (i.e. sons of Abraham, but not of Sarah); a. fr.
